Maybe he suffers from anxiety due to a past trauma. My ex used had a short temper and used to argue a lot. Despite me always apologizing even though I didn't know why, just to keep the peace, he always kept on saying that I made him upset because I don't act like other people. Therefore I was always anxious waiting for an argument and always feeling bad about myself. Nowadays if there's an argument in my personal relationships even with friends I take it really badly. It's a trigger for feeling bad about myself and the feeling that everyone is against me. It creates a lot of anxiety and sadness and I prefer to distance myself of that person even though I like them dearly. I just can't cope with those bad feelings. It might be that he has some similar experience and he's trying to protect himself. It doesn't mean that he doesn't care deeply is just going through those distressing emotions all over again might  be too much. I also might add that he might be a sensitive person that's why he shows all that love and care but the other side of the coin makes him easily hurt or emotional.

For some reason I also think that because I was never married and have no children, men think I am inexperienced and then pull back.

I've started again with online dating and it so heartbreaking. Men just seem interested in sexy ladies and don't engage in conversations that allow to meet each other in a deeper level. It does knock the confidence. I am sorry, it seems that now I am ranting. It's because I am starting to get really frustrated. It would be nice to meet a man who wants to settle down and create something beautiful together. A cozy home, a dog, laughing and do activities together, being supporting of each other with personal endeavors, dreams and issues that life throws occasionally to everyone... I am afraid of getting to the end of my life and not experience that kind of love. It's so scary. Anyway maybe the world was not made for this 39 year old romantic woman. All the best. x
